Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing gifts under twenty dollars to municipal officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to gifts to municipal officers; and amending RCW42.23.070.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 42.23.070 and 1994 c 154 s 121 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No municipal officer may use his or her position to securespecial privileges or exemptions for himself, herself, or others. (2) No municipal officer may, directly or indirectly, give orreceive or agree to receive any compensation, gift, reward, or gratuityfrom a source except the employing municipality, for a matter connectedwith or related to the officer's services as such an officer unlessotherwise provided for by law. Gift does not include any item valuedat twenty dollars or less that cannot reasonably be presumed toinfluence the vote, action, or judgment of the municipal officer or beconsidered as part of a reward for action or inaction. (3) No municipal officer may accept employment or engage inbusiness or professional activity that the officer might reasonablyexpect would require or induce him or her by reason of his or her p. 1 SB 6507official position to disclose confidential information acquired byreason of his or her official position. (4) No municipal officer may disclose confidential informationgained by reason of the officer's position, nor may the officerotherwise use such information for his or her personal gain or benefit.
